name: Guest Identity
summary: Describes anonymous participation before a durable identity has been resolved.

values.name: None
values.summary: No guest identity or guest-owned interaction is active.

values.name: Active
values.summary: A guest session is active and may own conversation state or ephemeral work.

values.name: Claim Pending
values.summary: The guest identity is being associated with a resolved durable identity.

values.name: Claimed
values.summary: The guest-owned interaction has been attached to a durable identity.

values.name: Expired
values.summary: The guest identity can no longer be resumed or claimed.
